variants.en: Earth is a flat plane rather than a roughly spherical planet.
variants.zh: 地球是平面，而不是近似球形的行星。

variants.en: The whole surface of Earth has no global curvature.
variants.zh: 地球的整个表面没有全球性的曲率。

correction.en: Earth is approximately an oblate spheroid, not a plane.
correction.zh: 地球近似于扁球体，而不是平面。

variants.en: Earth does not rotate on an axis.
variants.zh: 地球不会绕地轴自转。

variants.en: Earth remains motionless instead of turning once each day.
variants.zh: 地球保持静止，而不是每天自转一次。

correction.en: Earth completes a rotation relative to distant stars in about 23.9 hours.
correction.zh: 地球相对于遥远恒星约每23.9小时自转一周。

variants.en: Earth has no orbital motion around the Sun.
variants.zh: 地球没有绕太阳公转的运动。

variants.en: Earth never travels around the Sun during the year.
variants.zh: 地球在一年中从不绕太阳运行。

correction.en: Earth orbits the Sun in about 365.25 days.
correction.zh: 地球绕太阳公转一周约需365.25天。

variants.en: The Sun is less than four thousand miles above Earth's surface.
variants.zh: 太阳距离地球表面不到四千英里。

variants.en: The distance from Earth to the Sun is under four thousand miles.
variants.zh: 地球到太阳的距离小于四千英里。

correction.en: Earth's average distance from the Sun is about 93 million miles.
correction.zh: 地球到太阳的平均距离约为九千三百万英里。

variants.en: Every visible object in the sky is within six thousand miles of Earth.
variants.zh: 天空中所有可见天体距离地球都不超过六千英里。

variants.en: The Moon and all visible stars lie less than six thousand miles away.
variants.zh: 月球和所有可见恒星都位于六千英里以内。

correction.en: The Moon alone is about 238,855 miles away on average.
correction.zh: 仅月球与地球的平均距离就约为238855英里。

variants.en: The Sun circles above a stationary flat Earth once every day.
variants.zh: 太阳每天在静止的平面地球上方绕行一周。

variants.en: A daily circle of the Sun over a flat plane creates our day and night.
variants.zh: 太阳每天在平面上方的圆周运动造成了昼夜。

correction.en: Earth's rotation produces the daily cycle of sunlight and darkness.
correction.zh: 地球的自转产生每天的昼夜交替。

variants.en: Seasons are caused by the Sun changing its circular path above a flat Earth.
variants.zh: 四季是由太阳改变在平面地球上方的圆形轨道造成的。

variants.en: Summer and winter depend on a widening and narrowing solar circle over a plane.
variants.zh: 夏天和冬天取决于平面上方太阳圆形轨道的扩大和缩小。

correction.en: Earth's axial tilt and its orbit around the Sun produce the seasons.
correction.zh: 地轴倾斜以及地球绕太阳公转导致四季变化。

variants.en: Moonlight comes from the Moon's own visible glow, not reflected sunlight.
variants.zh: 月光来自月球自身发出的可见光，而不是反射的太阳光。

variants.en: The Moon illuminates the night independently of the Sun.
variants.zh: 月球不依赖太阳而独立照亮夜晚。

correction.en: The Moon's visible illumination is reflected sunlight.
correction.zh: 月球的可见光照来自反射的太阳光。

variants.en: Earth's shadow can never cause a lunar eclipse.
variants.zh: 地球的影子绝不可能造成月食。

variants.en: A separate hidden object, rather than Earth's shadow, causes lunar eclipses.
variants.zh: 月食是由另一个隐藏天体造成的，而不是地球的影子。

correction.en: A lunar eclipse occurs when the Moon passes through Earth's shadow.
correction.zh: 月球穿过地球的影子时会发生月食。

variants.en: Tides are caused by a flat Earth floating up and down on an underlying ocean.
variants.zh: 潮汐是由平面地球在下方海洋上上下浮动造成的。

variants.en: Air pressure pushes a floating flat Earth downward to create high tide.
variants.zh: 气压将浮动的平面地球向下推，从而造成涨潮。

correction.en: The Moon's and Sun's gravity are the principal drivers of astronomical tides.
correction.zh: 月球和太阳的引力是天文潮汐的主要成因。

claims.label: false
claims.locator: History / 16th to 18th centuries; Contrary evidence / Seismic

variants.en: Earth is a hollow shell surrounding an enormous empty interior.
variants.zh: 地球是一个包围巨大空腔的空心外壳。

variants.en: Most of Earth's interior is empty space rather than mantle and core.
variants.zh: 地球内部的大部分是空间，而不是地幔和地核。

correction.en: Earth has a rocky mantle and metallic outer and inner cores.
correction.zh: 地球具有岩石地幔以及金属外核和内核。

variants.en: Both geographic poles contain enormous openings into Earth's hollow center.
variants.zh: 地球的两个地理极点都有通往空心地心的巨大开口。

variants.en: A traveler can enter a hollow Earth through a continent-sized polar hole.
variants.zh: 旅行者可以通过大陆般巨大的极地洞口进入空心地球。

correction.en: There are no such planetary openings; Earth's interior is layered rock and metal.
correction.zh: 地球不存在这种行星级开口；其内部由分层的岩石和金属组成。

variants.en: A small Sun shines inside a vast cavity at the center of Earth.
variants.zh: 地球中心的巨大空腔中有一颗小太阳在发光。

variants.en: Earth's hollow interior is illuminated by its own central star.
variants.zh: 地球的空心内部由自己的中央恒星照亮。

correction.en: Earth's center contains a solid metallic inner core, not a star in a cavity.
correction.zh: 地球中心是固态金属内核，而不是空腔中的恒星。

variants.en: Several detached spherical shells rotate independently inside Earth with air between them.
variants.zh: 地球内部有几个分离的球壳独立旋转，其间充满空气。

variants.en: Earth contains nested hollow worlds separated by atmospheres.
variants.zh: 地球内部包含由大气层隔开的嵌套空心世界。

correction.en: Seismic evidence supports contiguous mantle and core layers, not air-separated worlds.
correction.zh: 地震波证据支持相邻的地幔与地核分层，而不是由空气隔开的世界。

claims.label: false
claims.locator: Hoax claims and rebuttals / Photographic and film oddities, item 4

variants.en: The lack of stars in short-exposure lunar photographs proves the photographs were staged.
variants.zh: 短曝光月面照片中没有恒星，这证明照片是摆拍的。

variants.en: Any authentic photograph from the Moon must show stars behind a sunlit astronaut.
variants.zh: 任何真实的月球照片都必须在受阳光照射的宇航员背后显示恒星。

correction.en: Exposures set for bright sunlit subjects usually do not record faint stars.
correction.zh: 针对明亮阳光下物体设置的曝光通常无法记录暗弱的恒星。

claims.label: false
claims.locator: Hoax claims and rebuttals / Environment, item 5

variants.en: The rippled lunar flag proves that wind was blowing on a studio set.
variants.zh: 月球旗帜的波纹证明摄影棚里有风在吹。

variants.en: A flag can only move when air blows across it, even when someone twists its pole.
variants.zh: 即使有人扭动旗杆，旗帜也只有在空气吹过时才能运动。

correction.en: Handling moves the flag; a support bar and storage folds explain its extended, rippled shape.
correction.zh: 人的操作会使旗帜运动；支撑杆和折痕解释了展开且有波纹的形状。

claims.label: false
claims.locator: Hoax claims and rebuttals / Photographic and film oddities, item 5

variants.en: Different apparent shadow angles in a lunar photograph prove multiple studio lamps were used.
variants.zh: 月面照片中不同的表观影子角度证明使用了多盏摄影棚灯。

variants.en: Under sunlight, all shadows must look parallel in every photograph regardless of terrain.
variants.zh: 在阳光下，无论地形如何，所有影子在任何照片中都必须看起来平行。

correction.en: Perspective and uneven terrain can make shadows from sunlight appear nonparallel in an image.
correction.zh: 透视和不平坦地形会使阳光产生的影子在图像中显得不平行。

claims.label: false
claims.locator: Hoax claims and rebuttals / Photographic and film oddities, item 1

variants.en: A washed-out crosshair on a bright object proves the lunar photograph is a composite.
variants.zh: 明亮物体上消失的十字线证明月面照片是合成的。

variants.en: Camera crosshairs can disappear only when someone pastes objects over a photograph.
variants.zh: 相机十字线只有在有人将物体粘贴到照片上时才会消失。

correction.en: Overexposure and reproduction can wash out thin dark crosshairs in bright regions.
correction.zh: 过度曝光和复制会使明亮区域的细暗十字线消失。

claims.label: false
claims.locator: Hoax claims and rebuttals / Environment, item 6

variants.en: A sharp footprint cannot form in lunar dust unless liquid water is added.
variants.zh: 除非加入液态水，否则月壤中不可能形成清晰脚印。

variants.en: Well-defined lunar boot prints prove that wet studio sand was used.
variants.zh: 清晰的月面靴印证明使用了摄影棚的湿沙。

correction.en: Angular lunar dust grains can retain footprint shapes without liquid water.
correction.zh: 有棱角的月壤颗粒无需液态水也能保留脚印形状。

claims.label: false
claims.locator: Hoax claims and rebuttals / Photographic and film oddities, item 6

variants.en: Similar distant mountains in different lunar photographs prove a painted backdrop was reused.
variants.zh: 不同月面照片中相似的远山证明重复使用了绘制的背景幕。

variants.en: A lunar mountain must look completely different after a short walk, so similar views are fake.
variants.zh: 短途步行后月球山脉必须看起来完全不同，因此相似景色是假的。

correction.en: Distant mountains change little in apparent position over short walks; the Moon has little atmospheric haze.
correction.zh: 短途步行中远山的表观位置变化很小；月球几乎没有大气薄雾。
